depth_targets.title: Guest OS access (SSH, serial console, screenshot, OS info)
limitations: No guest OS boots behind an instance, so there is nothing to SSH into, no serial console output, no screenshot preview and no OS Info (guest attributes).

depth_targets.title: Instance groups (unmanaged and managed)
limitations: Managed instance groups support a fixed target size stamped out of an instance template (resize really creates/deletes member instances); autoscaling policies and rolling-update (max-surge/max-unavailable) orchestration aren't simulated.

depth_targets.title: Observability, recommendations and VM Manager
limitations: Monitoring/Logging tabs, Recommender suggestions and VM Manager (Patch, OS policies, VM Extension Manager) aren't modeled.
